verdict.rationale: The evidence shows approvals in the Droid CLI terminal UI, tiered autonomy confirmations, and diff review and merge in the Factory App web/desktop. Nothing documents a mobile app or phone-based approval of agent decisions while agents keep running. Reaching Factory from a phone through Linear, Jira, or Slack would be a host-platform workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can approve key agent decisions from my phone while agents continue working
